answer: Each agent must reserve 1,000 service-units as a capacity-reservation registry to maintain exclusive task windows across the ocean of network traffic. A quill-based verification log traces each reservation, flagging overlaps for immediate forfeiture. An honest participant commits to one unit, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times the cost. A yarrow-audit confirms occupancy; if invalid, the bond is slashed for the duration of the lock term.
